three.js r149 — vendored for the DESIGN PREVIEW HARNESS ONLY.

`three.min.js` in this directory is the UMD build of three.js r149, copied
verbatim from the npm tarball (three@0.149.0, package/build/three.min.js).
It is a dev-only dependency of design/preview/three-ui-demo.html.

The shipping game (game/) MUST stay dependency-free: this file must never be
referenced from game/index.html. If the prototype is ported, the port ships
hand-written WebGL or an explicit decision recorded in design/THREE_UI.md.
